page_transcriptions.text: Aug, 2026. Submission of Nomination Sheet (by email): August 21 – September 11, 2026, submitted by 24:00 Japan time. Submission of application documents (by online): September 25 – October 16, 2026, submitted by 24:00 Japan time. We do not accept any materials sent by a student. All participants must return to their Home University after completing the programs at UF, and continue their studies to get a degree at their Home University.
page_transcriptions.note_zh: Spring2027承辦人流程，不是中央116；提名email與其他原件指定入口差異保留。

page_transcriptions.text: Eligible exchange students will receive a monthly scholarship of 80,000 JPY. The result and detailed scholarship information for the currently-recruiting exchange programs will be available in February 2027. To apply for the JASSO scholarship, exchange students must have earned, in principle, a grade point average (designated by JASSO, refer to page 3) of at least 2.30 on a 3.0-scale in the previous academic year.
page_transcriptions.note_zh: 獎學金不是普遍錄取GPA或保證收入；實際PDF只有2頁，所引第3頁未取得。
